verdict.rationale: The docs describe plugin marketplaces as catalogs that provide centralized discovery, version tracking and updates. The anthropics/skills repo can be registered as a marketplace and its skill bundles installed by name. The API guide also lists pre-built skill short names (pptx, xlsx, docx, pdf). However, discovery works at the plugin/bundle level through marketplaces you add yourself, and nothing shows a browse or search interface or a central public registry. missing for 10: a documented browse/search UI or command for listing available skills before install, a central public skills registry or leaderboard, and independent hands-on corroboration of the discovery experience.
